newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bridgestone said asking for TSR20 rubber in S'pore.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone said asking for TSR20 rubber in S'pore.

text.p: Bridgestone is said to be still seeking several hundred tonnes of TSR20 rubber on Thursday while the rest of the Singapore rubber market drifted lower in quiet dealings, traders said.
"I heard Bridgestone is still asking around for price quotes on TSR20 rubber," a dealer said. "I don't know if any deals have been done though."
Bridgestone was said to have bought several hundred tonnes of TSR20 rubber for far forward delivery over the past two days after managing to get suppliers to trim their prices, dealers said.
The rest of the market was quiet with most of the trade waiting for leads going into the afternoon session.

Traders said there were some deals for RSS1 and RSS3 grade rubber done in the morning but that the bulk of the transactions will only come in after the local trade sees how the Japanese market performs.

At 0445 GMT, August RSS3 was indicated at 108.25-110.25 U.S. cents a kg from 110.25 cents. July RSS1 was indicated at 155.50 Singapore cents (US$1.09) a kg from 157.00 cents. August TSR20 was indicated at 144.00-146.00 Singapore cents (US$1.01-$1.02) a kg from 146.50 cents. - (S$1.42 = US$1) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
